seven_b_shock.reason: Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct Q4_K_M takes about 4.4 seconds per prompt on this machine. The full shock grid on 84 tasks would add about three hours after the 420 base tasks, so time and cost shocks for 7B use this subset of the 84. Accuracy, market shares, the pass split, and the equalised-attribute probe still use the same tasks as the 1.5B and 3B models.
